canada.title: U.K. opts against joining Canada-led defence bank, pledges co-operation
canada.summary: The British government has turned down Ottawa’s attempts to have it join the international Defence, Security and Resilience Bank, though London says it will work in lockstep with Canada to meet NATO spending targets.

canada.title: Woman dies while waiting to go home after release from N.B. correctional centre
canada.summary: A woman in her 40s has died in hospital after a medical emergency at the New Brunswick Women's Correctional Centre in Miramichi, the Department of Justice and Public Safety says. She was waiting for transportation home after being released from remand. Coroner Services is investigating.

canada.title: Their friend died of cervical cancer. Now, they advocate for women’s health in N.S.
canada.summary: Following the death of their close friend from cervical cancer in 2020, two women in Nova Scotia were left wondering how things might have been different had she been diagnosed earlier. Six years later, they have raised over $4 million to improve technology and infrastructure for women's health.
